title: cerastium glabratum
intro: Cerastium glabratum, commonly known as Chickenclover, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium glabratum include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents present in Cerastium glabratum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
